Marco Luthi

📌 [...] Hi everyone, I'm Marco. I make small iPhone apps on my own. Badgey turns your iPhone into a name badge. Clip the phone to a lanyard and turn it upside down: the badge turns round to face the people in front of you and swings a little as you walk. Slide it top first into a chest pocket and it shrinks to a strip, so your name shows above the edge. The pocket check uses the front camera for a few seconds while the phone is upside down. A small model on the phone decides, and the frames are never stored. You can keep several badges (work, a conference, a meetup), add a link that turns into a QR code on the back, and choose a design: Classic, Office, Event, Minimal or Live, which moves. It's free with one badge; Pro is a one-time purchase. I'd love to hear where you'd wear it, and what's [...] purchase. I'd love to hear where you'd wear it, and what's missing.

results.title: Badge is the new age proof of work backed by anoymous reviews collected by AI agents : Badge Discussion Forums | Product Hunt
results.content:
Badge is proof-of-work backed by anonymous peer reviews. Our AI agents collect your work reviews from the people you’ve actually worked with and turn it into a clear, verified proof-of-work. Unlike LinkedIn recommendations, which are usually just performative favors, Badge reviews are anonymous—so you get the honest truth.

Here is how Badge helps: [...] The Tech: To prevent abuse, we run real-time sentiment analysis on every review. Agent asks you various questions on the skill and character to generate a review for you. This makes giving review easier. Work email authentication helps in ensuring reviews are not fake.

80 views

priyanshi sinha

Love seeing products rethink hiring beyond resumes. A single manager or HR perspective rarely captures the full picture of someone's impact. A 360° view from people who've actually worked together feels like a much stronger signal. Curious to see how Badge balances honest feedback with fairness as it scales—this is definitely an interesting space to watch. 👏

Report

Rahul Bhavsar [...] Here is how Badge helps:

 For Recruiters: Stop guessing based on a CV. Search a candidate’s LinkedIn, email, or phone number to see their actual aggregate performance.
 For Professionals: Your reputation shouldn't be trapped in a single company's HR portal. Our AI agent collects high-signal feedback from your peers to build a portable, 360-degree professional profile. Just give your first review, and our agent will help you gather feedback from your colleagues. You can then put your Badge QR on your resume or LinkedIn to show your real credibility.
